bias.en: Bearish · SAR bullish, boxed in at $284–292
bias.zh: 看空 · 抛物线 SAR 看多，困于 $284–292

read.en: Alphabet fell 0.3% on Nov 10 to $287.38, trading $285.68–292.02. It is above the 5-day ($286.4) and below the 10-day ($287.9), 30-day ($323.2), 100-day ($340.0) and 200-day ($339.1); all five averages are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($277.31), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月10日下跌 0.3%，收于 $287.38，盘中区间 $285.68–292.02。股价位于 5 日（$286.4）均线上方，10 日（$287.9）、30 日（$323.2）、100 日（$340.0）和 200 日（$339.1）均线下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$277.31），RSI 为 32。

read.en: No level changed: the $292.02 high stalled at the $290.5–292 resistance, and the $285.68 low stayed above the $283.4–284.9 support; the close is pinned between the 5-day ($286.4) and 10-day ($287.9). Resistance is $287.9–292, then $294.1–296.5 and $300. Support is $283.4–286.4, then $276.9–277.3 (SAR, late-October lows) and $270.7–272.1. A close above $296.5 would target $300; below $283.4, $277.
